author: Thermetrics
versionDescription: Fixed a real bug behind 'all lines received but the order stays stuck in Ordered': the Receive button's header-rollup step moves the order to Received/Partially Received, but those phases also require Approved By — any order missing that field (e.g. older orders from before it existed) silently failed on that last step, even though inventory/line updates had already gone through. Now defaults Approved By to whoever clicks Receive if the order doesn't already have one set.
